#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Unpack a .docx (zip) archive into a directory using only the standard library."""
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

src = Path(sys.argv[1])
dst = Path(sys.argv[2])
with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as zf:
    zf.extractall(dst)
print(f"Extracted {src} -> {dst}")
for name in sorted(zf.namelist()):
    print(name)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pack an unpacked directory back into a .docx zip using only the standard library.

Writes [Content_Types].xml first (convention), then all other files, and
replaces the output atomically.
"""
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

src = Path(sys.argv[1])
out = Path(sys.argv[2])
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

files = [p for p in src.rglob("*") if p.is_file()]


def sort_key(p):
    rel = p.relative_to(src).as_posix()
    if rel == "[Content_Types].xml":
        return (0, rel)
    return (1, rel)


tmp = out.with_suffix(out.suffix + ".tmp")
with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
    for p in sorted(files, key=sort_key):
        zf.write(p, p.relative_to(src).as_posix())
tmp.replace(out)
print(f"Packed {src} -> {out}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify that all headlines in the final .docx are underlined and body text is not."""
import sys
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path

docx_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
expected = [
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
]

W = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}"

with zipfile.ZipFile(docx_path) as zf:
    xml_bytes = zf.read("word/document.xml")

root = ET.fromstring(xml_bytes)

results = []
for p in root.iter(W + "p"):
    text = "".join(t.text or "" for t in p.iter(W + "t")).strip()
    if not text:
        continue
    underlined = any(
        u.get(W + "val") == "single"
        for r in p.iter(W + "r")
        for u in r.iter(W + "u")
    )
    is_upper = text.isupper() and any(c.isalpha() for c in text)
    results.append((text, underlined, is_upper))

ok = True
underlined_heads = [t for t, u, i in results if u]
non_head_underlined = [t for t, u, i in results if u and not i]
missing = [t for t in expected if t not in underlined_heads]
extra = [t for t, u, i in results if u and t not in expected]

print("Headlines with underline:", underlined_heads)
if missing:
    ok = False
    print("MISSING underline on expected headlines:", missing)
if extra:
    ok = False
    print("UNEXPECTED underlined paragraphs:", extra)
if non_head_underlined:
    print("Note: non-all-caps paragraphs that got underline:", non_head_underlined)

print("RESULT:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
